fact: On 28 February 2025 the Minister of Finance promulgated Statutory Instrument 17 of 2025 amending the 2020 money transmission and mobile banking regulations, setting a USD5,000 application fee and an annual licence fee of 2% of gross turnover capped at USD50,000 for payment service providers, whose licensing the Reserve Bank handles under its payment system recognition framework.
title: Understanding Zimbabwe's New Licensing Regulations for Money Transmission, Mobile Banking and Money Interoperability
